infobox.usage: Unlocks dorm room 118 in the three story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 118 key (Dorm 118) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the three-story dormitory with a tag reading "118" on it.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - In a key cabinet at the dorm guard desk that is located at the two-story dorms

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The first floor of the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Jacket
- Weapon repair kit spawn
- Possible CMMG Mk47 Mutant 7.62x39 assault rifle
- Possible Desert Tech MDR 5.56x45 assault rifle
- Possible Kalashnikov AK-104 7.62x39 assault rifle
- Possible Kalashnikov AKS-74UB 5.45x39 assault rifle
- Possible FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 assault rifle
- Possible Springfield Armory M1A 7.62x51 rifle
- Possible Rifle Dynamics RD-704 7.62x39 assault rifle
- Loose loot (Provisions, Medical items)
